options.name: auto_upgrade
options.description:
A boolean value indicating whether the cluster will be automatically upgraded to new patch
releases during its maintenance window.

options.name: client_override_options
options.description: Client override options (developer use). For example, can be used to override the DigitalOcean API endpoint for an internal test suite. If provided, these options will knock out existing options.

options.name: ha
options.description:
A boolean value indicating whether the control plane is run in a highly available
configuration in the cluster.
 Highly available control planes incur less downtime. The property cannot be disabled.

options.name: maintenance_policy
options.description: An object specifying the maintenance window policy for the Kubernetes cluster.

options.name: module_override_options
options.description: Module override options (developer use). Can be used to override module options to support experimental or future options. If provided, these options will knock out existing options.

options.name: name
options.description: A human-readable name for a Kubernetes cluster.

options.name: node_pools
options.description: An object specifying the details of the worker nodes available to the Kubernetes cluster.

options.name: region
options.description: The slug identifier for the region where the Kubernetes cluster is located.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the resource, C(present) to create, C(absent) to destroy.

options.name: surge_upgrade
options.description:
A boolean value indicating whether surge upgrade is enabled/disabled for the cluster. Surge upgrade makes cluster upgrades fast and reliable by bringing up new nodes before
destroying the outdated nodes.

options.name: tags
options.description: An array of tags applied to the Kubernetes cluster. All clusters are automatically tagged C(k8s) and C(k8s:$K8S_CLUSTER_ID).

options.name: token
options.description: DigitalOcean API token. There are several environment variables which can be used to provide this value. C(DIGITALOCEAN_ACCESS_TOKEN), C(DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN), C(DO_API_TOKEN), C(DO_API_KEY), C(DO_OAUTH_TOKEN) and C(OAUTH_TOKEN)

options.name: version
options.description:
The slug identifier for the version of Kubernetes used for the cluster. If set to a minor version (e.g. "1.14"), the latest version within it will be used
(e.g. "1.14.6-do.1").
 If set to "latest", the latest published version will be used. See the C(/v2/kubernetes/options endpoint) to find all currently available versions.

options.name: vpc_uuid
options.description: A string specifying the UUID of the VPC to which the Kubernetes cluster is assigned.
